components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action button with indigo fill and hover glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366F1; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: DocHarvest provides a high-density, precise engineering atmosphere designed for developers, AI engineers, and archival specialists.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian & Deep Slate Foundation avoiding pure harsh blacks
Precision Typography with tabular monospace accents
Restrained Vibrant Accents using indigo and warm amber

rules.name: The Signal-First Rule
rules.body: Color is used strictly to communicate status, interaction, or hierarchy. Maximum 10% accent coverage on any screen.

rules.name: The Tinted Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are never neutral gray; dark backgrounds carry deep blue/charcoal undertones.

rules.name: The Exact Ratio Rule
rules.body: Typographic hierarchy maintains at least a 1.25x scaling ratio between sequential heading tiers.

rules.name: The Monospace Distinction Rule
rules.body: All commands, hashes, JSON snippets, and file paths are rendered strictly in monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Containers rest on subtle border separation and tonal shifts; glow and elevation appear strictly on interactive hover or active state.

dos: Do maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for all text against backgrounds.
Do use solid, readable text colors rather than distracting multi-color gradient text.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by disabling heavy motion transitions.
Do provide full keyboard navigation with visible :focus-visible ring outlines.
Do use distinct monospace styling for CLI commands, paths, and technical parameters.
donts: Don't nest cards inside cards; separate sections using spacing, hierarchy, and dividers.
Don't use generic purple-to-violet SaaS gradients or unstyled default layouts.
Don't use low-contrast gray text on colored badge backgrounds.
Don't use decorative pulsing status animations on non-live static elements.
